# Gritty Fitness

> Gritty is an AI-powered fitness coaching app (iOS + Android) that builds and adapts one holistic, multi-sport training plan around each user — running, cycling, swimming, strength, mobility, and recovery. The AI coach, "Grit", builds the program from a plain-language goal, then reviews every workout (recorded in-app via GPS, or imported from Apple Health, Health Connect, or GPX/TCX/FIT/CSV files) and proposes adjustments the user approves. Free to use with optional Premium (€7.99/month or €69/year).

For the complete factual reference (sports, devices, imports, pricing, data handling), see [llms-full.txt](https://grittyfitness.app/llms-full.txt).
